ocean: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: actual scrolling ground texture for an original premium iOS top-down arcade spaceship shooter. Portrait 1024x1536. Strict orthographic top-down aerial view, no horizon, no perspective vanishing point. Scene: deep teal ocean with a narrow archipelago of lush rocky tropical islets near the left and right edges, intricate underwater turquoise reef shelves, realistic white coastal surf, one small sci-fi military dock at an edge. Beautiful detailed realistic painted 3D-rendered terrain, polished sci-fi game environment, rich material details and soft atmospheric depth. Terrain should feel far below the flying player. Keep the middle 55 percent mostly open and lower contrast to allow bright enemy bullets to read. Dark moderately muted exposure, not a black image. No aircraft, no enemies, no projectiles, no explosions, no UI, no labels, no text or watermark. Left and right edges more detailed; top and bottom edges must have similar colors and continuous environment for vertical scrolling. Finished production game background, original world and architecture.
